question: Does transplanting Robinson & Frueh 2025's NLL loss (Eq. 3, sigma_k weighting + signal rescaling) improve scoring/polish on seed 89, warranting adoption into the m048 production cost path?
hypothesis: RF25's NLL loss addresses the bright-peak overfitting seen in s058/s059 and should out-rank plain MSE; but with the fixed m048 noise floor the sigma-weighting collapses to ~MSE.
narrative_md: Staged A/B of RF25's NLL residual (opt-in, no production swap) on seed 89. Plain magnitude MSE tracks hi-fi rho perfectly (Spearman 1.000); NLL-rescale decorrelates it (0.555). Every full-LC score ranks truth worse than the cached local-window score; the full-LC-MSE control beats NLL on 19/20 re-polishes. Mechanism: flux-proportional sigma_k from the fixed 0.05-mag floor makes the weighting ~= MSE, and the signal rescaling hurts shape-wrong phantom basins. Decision: do not adopt into the m048 cost path. Scored against hi-fi/truth -> oracle_clean false. N=1 seed.
